THE RULE: a block is a `## ` or `### ` heading through the line before the next; CLOSED needs its subject settled AND its record standing in a report (named and read); OPEN is the default; a CLOSED ITEM is a bullet or numbered item inside an OPEN block that passes the same test on its own; a TABLE is a measurement's figures whose report holds every one (IM §0.7). THE COMMAND: four read-only readers, one slice each (lines 1-980, 981-2015, 2016-3026, 3027-4127), one rubric (the scratchpad's RUBRIC_state.md, reproduced in IQ's report §1), a frozen snapshot; each reader's bytes matched its slice. THE OUTPUT: one row a block (130 OPEN, 11 CLOSED) and one a closed item (95); `disposition` is what IQ did with it.
